title: Statistical dive into Denver Broncos record-tying 15th straight win in one-score games

sources.title: Statistical dive into Denver Broncos record-tying 15th straight win in one-score games
sources.description: The Denver Broncos have now won 15 straight regular season games that were decided by one-score (8 or fewer points). This ties the 2007-2008 Peyton Manning-led Colts.
